cohort: All mothers who presented to a study facility while pregnant, during childbirth, and/or within 42 days after termination of pregnancy seeking care
finding: The occurrence of SMO in the facility was high, with modifiable factors such as maternal age, residential area, educational status, occupation, ANC visits, mode of delivery, and duration of hospitalization being associated with SMO.
mod_finding: Delivery by emergency cesarean section was found to be protective of SMO.
